text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 15, 2024) for 4 Woodland Heights.

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 15, 2024) for 4 Woodland Heights, Folder Number 24 196825 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to July 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
